options: Query asks; key advertises relevance via dot product with the query; value carries the information actually retrieved

question: Why is the attention score divided by sqrt(d_k)?
options: To prevent dot products from growing large in high dimensions, which would push softmax into low-gradient regions
It's a typo in the original paper that everyone copies
To normalize the value vectors to unit length
To make the result an integer

It uses fewer parameters in all cases
It eliminates the need for tokenization
It runs only on CPUs, not GPUs
